tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Hárok1']
# source: brand in col B, category in row 5 (A5:S5). value at row r, col c
# target: L5:S5 categories, M6:S11 brands
# For each target cell (col c in L..S, row r in 6..11):
#   brand = ws['M6'] (row r), category = ws[c5]
#   value = source row r, source col of category
# write formula
for c in range(12,19):
    for r in range(6,12):
        cat = ws.cell(5,c).value
        brand = ws.cell(r,13).value
        # source col of category: find col where row5==cat
        src_col = None
        for cc in range(1,10):
            if ws.cell(5,cc).value==cat:
                src_col=cc
        f = f'=INDEX(\$B\$6:\$H\$19,MATCH(\$M\$6,\$B\$6:\$B\$19,0),MATCH(\"{cat}\",\$A\$5:\$H\$5,0))'
        ws.cell(r,c).value=f
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
